EXICOM | website = {{URL|https://hfcl.com/|hfcl.com}} | footnotes = }} '''HFCL Limited''' is an Indian [[technology company]] which designs, develops, manufactures [[telecommunications equipment]], [[Fiber-optic cable|fibre-optic cables]] and other related electronics.{{cite web |title=Here's What We Like About HFCL's (NSE:HFCL) Upcoming Dividend |url=https://simplywall.st/stocks/in/telecom/nse-hfcl/hfcl-shares/news/heres-what-we-like-about-hfcls-nsehfcl-upcoming-dividend |website=simplywall.st|date=16 September 2021 }}{{cite web |title=HFCL Management Information - Details of HFCL Management |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/hfcl-ltd/infocompanymanagement/companyid-13649.cms |website=The Economic Times}} The company is based in [[Gurugram]] and listed on both the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] (BSE){{cite web |title=Stock Share Price {{!}} Get Quote {{!}} BSE |url=https://www.bseindia.com/stock-share-price/hfcl-ltd/hfcl/500183/ |website=www.bseindia.com}} and the [[National Stock Exchange of India|National Stock Exchange]] (NSE).{{cite web |title=HFCL Limited |url=https://www1.nseindia.com/live_market/dynaContent/live_watch/get_quote/GetQuote.jsp?symbol=HFCL |website=NSE India}} It serves various industries, such as [[telecommunications]], [[security]] and [[Indian Railways|railways]], [[textiles]], [[Fiber|Cable fibre]].{{cite web |title=Check out HFCL Ltd's stock price (HFCL-IN) in real time |url=https://www.cnbc.com/quotes/HFCL-IN |website=CNBC |date=29 January 2012 |language=en}} ==History== In 1987, Himachal Futuristic Communications Limited was co-founded by Mahendra Nahata, Deepak Malhotra and Vinay Maloo. In May 1987, the company was incorporated as public limited company in the state of [[Himachal Pradesh]].{{Cite web|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/hfcl-ltd/infocompanyhistory/companyid-13649.cms|title=HFCL History | HFCL Information - The Economic Times|website=economictimes.indiatimes.com}} The company set up manufacturing facilities in India for optical fibre cables, optical transport, power electronics and broadband equipment, and provided turnkey solutions to the [[Government of India]]'s undertakings and private sector players across the world.{{citation needed|date=January 2023}}. It has ties with [[Centre for Development of Telematics|C-DOT]], C-DOT has agreed to transfer its technology to HFCL.{{cite web | url=https://telecom.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/state-run-telecom-rd-firm-c-dot-hopeful-for-telco-business/51939882 | title=State-run telecom R&D firm C-DOT hopeful for telco business - ET Telecom }} In 1995, company's [[Indian rupee|₹]]85,000 [[crore]] ($25 billion) bid for basic services license in India created the momentum for telecom industry in the country.{{cite web |last1=Sharma |first1=Pranjal |title=HFCL's over-confidence queers pitch for other private operators, puts telecom Ministry in spot |url=https://www.indiatoday.in/magazine/economy/story/19950930-hfcl-over-confidence-queers-pitch-for-other-private-operators-puts-telecom-ministry-in-spot-808233-1995-09-30 |website=India Today |date=30 September 1995 |language=en}} In 2000, [[Australia]]n businessman [[Kerry Packer]] known for his contribution to the sport of [[cricket]], invested in the company and took 10% stake.{{cite web |last1=Ghosh |first1=Partha |title=Kerry Packer co acquires 10 pc stake in HFCL -- Two new ventures set up |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/todays-paper/tp-others/article29055033.ece |website=@businessline |date=7 March 2000 |language=en}} CPH and HFCL set up two [[joint venture]] firms, one for software products and services and other for [[B2B e-commerce]].{{cite news |title=HFCL starts commercial production of optical fiber cables in Hyderabad facility |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/telecom/telecom-news/hfcl-starts-commercial-production-of-optical-fiber-cables-in-hyderabad-facility/articleshow/79777306.cms |website=The Economic Times}} In 2018, HFCL launched its optical fibre manufacturing unit in [[Hyderabad]].{{cite web |title=HFCL Launches Optical Fiber Manufacturing Facility in Hyderabad {{!}} Information Technology, Electronics & Communications Department, Government of Telangana, India |url=https://it.telangana.gov.in/hfcl-launches-optical-fiber-manufacturing-facility-in-hyderabad/ |website=it.telangana.gov.in|date=13 March 2018 }}{{cite web |title=HFCL shares zoom 100% in one month. More gains ahead? |url=https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-market-news/hfcl-shares-zoom-100-in-one-month-more-gains-ahead-11625571876656.html |website=mint |language=en |date=6 July 2021}} ==Operations== HFCL has its headquarters in [[Gurgaon|Gurugram]] and production plants in [[Solan]] ([[Himachal Pradesh]]), [[Chennai]] ([[Tamil Nadu]]) and [[Goa]]. The company's regional offices are located in Indian states of [[Punjab]], [[Rajasthan]], [[Uttar Pradesh]], [[West Bengal]], [[Orissa]], [[Madhya Pradesh]], [[Maharashtra]], [[Andhra Pradesh]], [[Bihar]], [[Kerala]], [[Jharkhand]] and [[Uttarakhand]].{{Cite web|last=News|first=Rashtra|date=2022-01-07|title=HFCL Accelerates International Business, further Strengthens its Leadership Team with Three New Leaders|url=https://www.rashtranews.com/hfcl-accelerates-international-business-further-strengthens-its-leadership-team-with-three-new-leaders/|access-date=2022-02-28|website=rashtranews.com|language=en-US}} ==Subsidiaries== *HFCL Advance Systems *Moneta Finance Ltd *HTL Limited *DragonWave HFCL Ltd. *Microwave Communications *Polixel Security Systems ==See also== *[[Telecommunications in India]] *[[Fiber-optic communication|Fibre-optic communication]] ==References== {{reflist}} {{Telecommunication companies of India}} [[Category:Telecommunications companies of India]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1987]] [[Category:Conglomerate companies established in 1987]] [[Category:Companies based in New Delhi]] [[Category:1987 establishments in India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]]
extract:
HFCL Limited is an Indian technology company which designs, develops, manufactures telecommunications equipment, fibre-optic cables and other related electronics.
The company is based in Gurugram and listed on both the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) and the National Stock Exchange (NSE). It serves various industries, such as telecommunications, security and railways, textiles, Cable fibre.
